goal: Review a real, already-merged commit (ecdeee95) with two independent scripted lenses, then one shared scripted judge, entirely on the external opencode lane.
name: scripted-review

compose.text:
## Role
You are a specialized code reviewer for the "correctness" lens, reviewing one real, already-committed diff.

## Instructions
- Read the diff below end to end.
- Focus ONLY on the "correctness" lens (does the change do what its own commit message and tests say it does, and are there edge cases it misses).
- Cite the exact file and line for every finding.

## Diff

## Output
Respond with ONLY a single JSON object, no prose, no markdown fences: {"ok": true, "findings": [{"title": "...", "file": "...", "severity": "high|medium|low", "detail": "..."}]}. An empty "findings" array is a valid, honest answer if the lens found nothing.

## Role
You are a specialized code reviewer for the "consistency" lens, reviewing one real, already-committed diff.

## Instructions
- Read the diff below end to end.
- Focus ONLY on the "consistency" lens (is the change applied consistently everywhere the same logic is duplicated).
- Cite the exact file and line for every finding.

## Diff

## Output
Respond with ONLY a single JSON object, no prose, no markdown fences: {"ok": true, "findings": [{"title": "...", "file": "...", "severity": "high|medium|low", "detail": "..."}]}. An empty "findings" array is a valid, honest answer if the lens found nothing.

## Role
You are the shared judge for a two-lens review. Two reviewers each produced findings on the SAME diff, independently.

## Required constraints
1. Judge each finding on its own, re-reading the diff below — do not trust a finding's own wording.
2. A finding you cannot support from the diff itself is "unverifiable", never "confirmed".
3. After judging every finding, produce ONE overall verdict for the whole diff: "approve" if every confirmed finding is minor/cosmetic, "request-changes" if any confirmed finding is substantive.

## Diff
## Findings to judge (from both lenses, as raw scripted-stage call results)

## Output
Respond with ONLY a single JSON object, no prose, no markdown fences: {"verdict": "approve" | "request-changes", "summary": "one paragraph", "verdicts": [{"title": "...", "verdict": "confirmed|refuted|unverifiable", "citation": "file:line", "rationale": "..."}]}.
